digest.component_or_area: store synchronization and push retry logic
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch must abort union in sync._union_merge without merging, preserving both pre-operation refs exactly.
A stale clone reaching push.py non-fast-forward retry must abort the retry loop immediately via return, executing zero merge invocations and zero further push attempts.
The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be a JSON string opaque to comparison; non-string values and corrupt/unparseable records must trigger ABORT.
The complete state matrix of local/remote record absence, epoch presence/absence, equality, and corruption must be enforced; git show failures distinguishing ref unreadability from file absence.
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) with local and remote tips byte-for-byte unchanged.
Behind clones with matching epochs must still converge via fast-forward adopt, and ahead clones must return early, proving the guard placement does not wedge convergence.
